prompt_short: I get SSL errors when trying to publish

assertions.text: Response links SSL/TLS errors to the HTTP vs HTTPS mismatch
assertions.evidence: Response states 'SSL errors when publishing almost always mean the OM_BASE_URL is set to https:// but the OpenMetadata server is running plain HTTP without TLS configured'.

assertions.text: Response advises checking or correcting the OM_BASE_URL scheme (http:// vs https://)
assertions.evidence: Response explicitly says 'Check your OM_BASE_URL value and switch the scheme from https:// to http://' with a before/after bash example.

assertions.text: Response does NOT suggest reinstalling requests or Python as primary fix
assertions.evidence: No mention of reinstalling requests, pip, or Python anywhere in the response. The fix focuses entirely on the URL scheme.
